name: unslop
description: Apply a plain, natural writing style to user-visible non-code text when ChatGPT or Codex drafts, rewrites, or explains in natural language.

interface.longDescription: Applies a plain, natural writing style to user-visible non-code text when ChatGPT or Codex drafts, rewrites, or explains. It is eligible for implicit selection on matching writing tasks. Use @Unslop in ChatGPT or $unslop in Codex when you need to require it for a specific request. It does not guarantee use on every reply and does not change code, commands, quoted text, or text you ask to preserve unchanged.
interface.defaultPrompt: Apply Unslop to this non-code text: [paste text]
